comments:
Same person as gTsang nags phug pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'od zer (ID:6640)?
Late 13th-early 14th c. according to van der Kuijp ([H9MPLMTV]: 22). 
Late 12th-early 13th c. according to [MX3PRVV2]: 3/16 and n. 4.
Considered to be identical with gNyal zhig's student 'Jam dbyangs gsar ma ([4LWBNM7B]: 121).
Important master in the Dro lineage of the Kālacakra ([MX3PRVV2]).
A list of his compositions is discussed in [MX3PRVV2]: 7-8/16.
